title: The thirtieth bomb
what_we_know: The B-15 carries thirty bomb symbols. Subtracting two missions in borrowed aircraft, the crew record accounts for twenty-nine.
what_we_dont: What the thirtieth symbol counts: a mission not carried under 44-6838's tail number, a training or ferry flight, or a miscount.
what_might_answer_it: The aircraft's own record of sorties; anyone who painted or saw the jacket painted.
evidence_needed: A sortie in 44-6838 not in the crew record, or an account of the painting.
